title: Design: the simulator columns keep their place between view and edit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the simulator has a tier column.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Take a screenshot of the Price Part Simulator.
  4. Click Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view.

Step 3:

  • The screenshot is saved.

Step 4:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.
  • Compared with the screenshot, the simulator's Part Cost column and each price column keep their place and width: nothing moves sideways or down.
